entities.name: Hashaton
entities.description: A servant of the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: The vizier of Naktamun, who has glimpsed oblivion and learned lessons from it.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who once protected the edge of Naktamun and is now gone.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: An Amonkhet realm once protected by Kefnet, whose masters will be remembered.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A character who speaks for Avishkar's open greeting to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Pytamun
entities.description: A Nef-tomb priest whose resolve is strengthened by each cataclysm.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who calls Chandra her home and asks about foreign suns on Avishkar's flora.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Nissa calls home.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: A vizier of invocations who urges seeking the truth of their world.

entities.name: Tailpipe
entities.description: A Rocketeer.

entities.name: Varina
entities.description: The monarch of the Broken Lands who expects Naktamun to remember its masters.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An aether-seer who built a device to capture foreign sunlight for Nissa and urges never ceasing to create.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks about ideas that can never be killed.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An infamous figure of Avishkar's night markets who holds his seat because he alone is fit.

entities.name: Kadhu
entities.description: A skywhaler who knows when to use a harpoon.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who grafted the Planar Bridge into himself and whose agents demand citizens' inventions.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: Chief of Compliance.

entities.name: Stitcher Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher whose earliest work escapes him.

entities.name: Sai
entities.description: A master thopterist who prizes artistry in industry.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who wakes the dead and whispers to the remnants of Oketra and Bontu.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose remaining consciousness Liliana addresses.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose remaining consciousness Liliana addresses.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar who speaks of death no longer being a sanctuary.

entities.name: Kordel the Cryptic
entities.description: A speaker of paradoxical sayings.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who values exploration.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks about hierarchy.

entities.name: Tullus of Palandius
entities.description: A scholar who prefers own knowledge to dogma.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: An initiate of Tah crop who wonders about what lies beyond the Hekma.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist.

entities.name: Chianul
entities.description: A dream-whisperer of the dragon's skull.

entities.name: Alene
entities.description: A resident of Riverspan, built on a downed Phyrexian portal ship.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A Thran scholar.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: A faction lurking to reclaim Amonkhet from the living.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The former rulers of Avishkar, now gone.

entities.name: Rocketeers
entities.description: A goblin racing team.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild whose insignia is seen only by its members and the doomed.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild whose sigil is a sign of status or debt.

entities.name: The Scarab
entities.description: A figure served by Hashaton and awaited by prophets.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane formerly Kaladesh, where aether flows freely to all.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane where dead does not mean gone.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A world of death and decay.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's far-off homeworld.

events.summary: Avishkar replaces Kaladesh and aether begins to flow freely to all.
events.quote: As Kaladesh became Avishkar, aether finally started flowing freely to all.

events.summary: Liliana whispers to the remnants of Oketra and Bontu to act against the usurper.
events.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

events.summary: Tezzeret grafts the Planar Bridge into himself.
events.quote: "When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body.

events.summary: Nissa asks whether foreign sunlight could affect Avishkar's flora through Omenpaths and Rashmi builds a device.
events.quote: I built a device to capture such light for further testing."

relations.note: He serves the Scarab in any form.
relations.quote: "I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name.
"Zendikar still seems so far off, but Chandra is my home."
